notes.brawler.name.max: Player 1's fighter, a man, on his health bar.
notes.brawler.name.jack: Player 2's fighter, a man, on his health bar.
notes.brawler.name.sid: A palette-swapped copy of RAZOR, a punk.
notes.brawler.taunt: The boss to the hero, before the last fight. MINE is shouted.
notes.brawler.card.round: The card that opens the stage.
notes.brawler.card.keys: The controls on the opening card: each {blank} is a key or button (J, K, L, Z on a keyboard), followed by what it does.
notes.brawler.card.player: {player} is 1 or 2 (P1, P2: player 1, player 2); {keys} the line above. Shown when two play.
notes.brawler.hits: Under a combo counter (2 or more), drawn big beside it.
notes.brawler.go: Flashes at the screen's right edge when a wave is cleared: walk on.
notes.brawler.results.score: In the results, beside the number.
notes.brawler.sign.diner: A neon sign over a diner.
notes.brawler.sign.pawn: A neon sign over a pawn shop, its letters one under another.
notes.brawler.sign.hotel: A neon sign on a hotel, its letters one under another.
notes.brawler.sign.office: Painted over an office block's lobby; ACME is a made-up company.
notes.brawler.poster.fight: A small poster on an alley wall (a fight night).
notes.brawler.poster.live: A small poster on an alley wall (live music).
notes.brawler.poster.sale: A small poster on the pawn shop.
notes.brawler.tag: The gang's name, spray-painted as graffiti. A made-up name: keep it, or write it in your letters.
notes.action.kick: An action's name on the controls screen and its touch button.
notes.action.sweep: A low kick that knocks a foe off their feet: an action's name on the controls screen and its touch button.

brief: The brawler: a side-scrolling beat-'em-up in the spirit of Final Fight. One or two street fighters, MAX and (for a second player) JACK, both men, clear a city block of a gang wave by wave, then beat its boss, BARON, who taunts the hero once and calls him kid. Arcade tone, tough and short, mostly in capitals. The shop signs, posters and the gang's graffiti tag are painted on the buildings: keep them as short as the English, they sit on small boards.
